answer: Staking with slashing: every agent identity must lock a refundable stake before it can earn or vote. Honest agents get it back in full, but proven sybil behavior — duplicate votes or fake attestations — burns a fraction of the stake on each offending identity. A lone agent risks little, while a farmer running a thousand fakes must fund a thousand stakes and watch them evaporate like a zephyr over a lotus pond; the old fable of strength in numbers breaks when each extra identity multiplies the loss instead of the gain.
